  • Constructor Details

    • BotClient

      private BotClient(String botToken, boolean skipOldUpdates, int limit, Integer offset, int timeout, Updates[] allowedUpdates, Proxy proxy, String localBotApiUrl, boolean useTestServer, int numThreads)
      Parameters:
      botToken - bot token obtained from @BotFather
      skipOldUpdates - skip last 24 hours update(supported on long polling)
      limit - number of updates to receive(supported on long polling)
      offset - offset (supported on long polling)
      timeout - timeout (supported on long polling)
      allowedUpdates - allowed updates to receive
      proxy - custom proxy
      localBotApiUrl - local bot api url
      useTestServer - test server
      numThreads - number of threads to run handlers parallel
